_readme: Edit `to`, set `status` to "approved", then run: node client/scripts/copyRewrites.cjs apply. status: pending | approved | applied | skip. Re-scan keeps your edits (matched by id). `to` is pre-filled only where the rewrite is mechanical (eyebrow sentence case, emoji removal); em-dash and voice entries need a human rewrite. `styles` lists every class string that makes an eyebrow — eyebrow text changes alone leave the caps look in place.
